results.idea: I want to enroll students in a language school through WhatsApp: explain courses, choose a class and confirm enrollment. This is a fictional test; do not send messages or perform real operations.

content.title: Student Enrollment via WhatsApp
content.summary: Enroll students in language courses using WhatsApp, allowing them to inquire about courses, choose classes, and confirm their enrollment.
content.hypothesis: The target audience includes students interested in learning a new language through a convenient and accessible platform like WhatsApp. Confirmation of actual interest and the effectiveness of the WhatsApp channel should be evaluated.
roles: WhatsApp as the main communication channel

screens.description: Display available language courses with details like duration, schedule, and pricing.

journey.label: Start Enrollment Process
journey.description: Begin the enrollment process by requesting course information via WhatsApp.

journey.label: Select Class
journey.description: User selects a class time from the options provided.

journey.label: Confirm Enrollment
journey.description: User confirms their enrollment and receives a confirmation email.

limitations: The effectiveness of WhatsApp as a communication channel needs to be evaluated.
User engagement levels may vary based on course offerings.
Automated responses may not cover all user inquiries effectively.
Confirmation of enrollment requires manual review to ensure accuracy.
content.disclaimer: Exploratory concept. This is not a final proposal, approval or published product.
